pre_install: Get-Process -Name 'Aurora' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0) { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null; if (-not $_.WaitForExit(5000)) { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force } } else { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force } }
if (-not $exe) { throw 'Aurora.exe was not found in the extracted MSI package' }
pre_uninstall: Get-Process -Name 'Aurora' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0) { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null; if (-not $_.WaitForExit(5000)) { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force } } else { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force } }
